well.definitionKo: 충분히 익을 정도로 몹시 끓이거나 삶는 모양.
well.englishDescription: A word describing an act of boiling or steaming something until it is completely cooked.

well.definitionKo: 푹 익을 정도로 오랫동안 끓이거나 삶는 모양.
well.englishDescription: A word describing an act of boiling or steaming something until it is completely cooked.

well.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 대상에 대해 잘 알고 있는 상태로.
well.englishDescription: In the state of having an accurate and deep knowledge about a certain task or object.

well.definitionKo: 칭찬할 만큼 매우 좋고 뛰어나게.
well.englishDescription: In the manner of being extremely good and excellent enough to be praised.

well.definitionKo: 상대방의 물음이나 요구에 대하여 분명하지 않은 태도를 나타낼 때 쓰는 말.
well.englishDescription: An exclamation used when showing an uncertain attitude toward someone's question or demand.

workforce.definitionKo: 일을 하는 데 쓰이는 사람의 정신적이고 육체적인 능력.
workforce.englishDescription: The mental and physical competency of a person, necessary for a certain work.
A person who works at a company.

workforce.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하는 데 필요한 인원.
workforce.englishDescription: The manpower necessary for doing something.

yo-heave-ho.definitionKo: 여러 사람이 힘을 합치면서 기운을 내기 위해 함께 내는 소리.
yo-heave-ho.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered by many people to gather energy and muster their strength.

yugwa.definitionKo: 쌀가루나 밀가루 반죽을 일정한 모양으로 빚어서 기름에 튀긴 후에 꿀이나 조청을 바르고 깨 등을 입힌 한국의 전통 과자.
yugwa.englishDescription: Primarily to lure children by deceiving them for the purpose of demanding money, etc.
